description: This file defines the `QueryResult` class, a generic Java class used to represent the result of query commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes references to command and response data, implements the `Result` interface, and provides a visitor pattern method.

classes.name: QueryResult
classes.description: A final class representing the result of a query command, parameterized by event type `E`. Implements the `Result` interface and contains references to the command issued and the response headers. Provides a `toString` method and an `accept` method for visitor pattern.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the QueryResult instance, including class name, command, and response.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a `ResultVisitor<E>` to perform operations based on the result; invokes `visitor.onQuery`.

methods.name: QueryResult
methods.description: Constructor initializing the query result with a command and response headers.
